title: TwinTail loopback web administrator configuration
description: Startup-only configuration. Every change requires exclusive reload. Use an environment secret reference for admin_token in stored config, never a literal; validation here operates on host-resolved values.

bind.description: Numeric loopback SocketAddr only. Non-loopback and invalid addresses are rejected before bind.

admin_token.description: Generate a random 32+ character secret. Configure using a host secret reference. Not returned by HTTP; changing requires restart and invalidates every browser session.
